description: ***ONLY SEAPORT MAC HOLDERS SHOULD RESPOND TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE*** Sources Sought Announcement for Air Cushion Vehicles (ACV) Crew, Safe Engineering and Operations (SEAOPS) Program, Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Program, and Future Connectors Program Support. A Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF) SeaPort NxG Task Order is anticipated for a base period of 12 months with four, one year option periods of 12 months each. Please see attachment N6133126SNQ25_Sources_Sought_Notice for more information. Only SeaPort MAC holders may be granted access to restricted attachments. Submissions from non-SeaPort MAC holders will not be considered.
